summary.text: Ari Brown, listed by Ballotpedia as Eric Ari Brown, is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly representing District 20, which he has represented since April 25, 2022, and is seeking re-election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Brown lives in Cedarhurst, New York, and has served on the board of trustees of the Incorporated Village of Cedarhurst.
For the 2025-2026 session, Brown was assigned to the Economic Development, Job Creation, Commerce and Industry; Education; Housing; Local Governments; and Small Business committees.
